GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 1.5 Lengths settling down, Held Together in front & led rail by just under a length turning, Headed Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted. Jockey explained he was instructed to help it begin and gave it a squeeze to settle further forward than its recent starts, although was surprised at its respoinse finding the lead with little effort. Trainer confirmed the instructions adding he expected it to race midfield or a little better. Comments noted.] # weak once headed

Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 10 Lengths 3 Wide , Eased finding cover rearward at 1300m, blocked at 600m, last trailing 7 Lengths turning, cut corner and improved into the race on straightening, Lost Ground in the run home # never a factor
